title: feat: keep underscores in Slugify
body:
## Goal
`slug.Slugify` turns underscores into hyphens, so a tool named `my_tool` gets the slug `my-tool` and collides with a tool named `my-tool`. Change Slugify to keep underscores as they are.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `Slugify("my_tool")` returns `my_tool`
- Spaces and other punctuation still become hyphens

## Dependencies
None
